content.body: Ah wasn't sure whether external contributors were allowed to be added. It seems like I was added already, thanks!

Sure, test samplers for dark | light: https://codepen.io/myf/full/KKbVpmN | https://codepen.io/myf/full/jOXWPGV . 
Interesting to watch over time; from recent progress, very glad to see that Firefox abandoned semi-transparent `highlight`. But the fact that some colours are same in both schemes (mark, highlight, accent) feels wrong. I wonder if there could be some good, accessible and aesthetic palette developers could actually build derived palettes fitting user's preferences, and not these odd (at best) or even broken values we cannot push very far without hitting some ugly/inaccessible shades.

(Thanks for fixing stuff, much appreciated! And it is true that primarily, activeText is not displayed long enough to pose accessibility risk, I guess, so NBD with non-AAA contrast.)
